clarity.description: Evaluation of prompt clarity and specificity
suggestions: Specify what constitutes a user's need more clearly.

structure.description: Assessment of reasoning flow and organization
suggestions: Ensure the order of the components in the output aligns with user expectations.
Provide more realistic examples to enhance understanding.
Use bullet points for listing expected output fields.
Emphasize that all fields in the output must be in JSON format.
Consider refining the input specifications for user needs and adding more detailed examples.
original_prompt: As a project manager, I want to create a Jira ticket that accurately reflects the user's needs. Please help me expand the following input into a comprehensive Jira ticket that includes the title, description, priority, and any relevant tags. Return the necessary components in strict JSON format, ensuring that each field is clearly defined. ### Example Input: - User's need: [User's actual need goes here] ### Expected Output: ```json { "title": "[Title of the Jira ticket]", "description": "[Detailed description of the issue]", "priority": "[Priority level]", "tags": ["[tag1]", "[tag2]"] } ```
enhanced_prompt: As a project manager, I want to create a Jira ticket that accurately reflects the user's needs. Please help me expand the following input into a comprehensive Jira ticket. The ticket should include the following components: - Title: A concise title for the ticket - Description: A detailed description of the user's needs - Priority: The priority level (e.g., Low, Medium, High) - Tags: Relevant tags associated with the ticket Please return the necessary components in strict JSON format, ensuring that each field is clearly defined. ### Example Input: - User's need: [User's actual need goes here] ### Expected Output: { "title": "[Title of the Jira ticket]", "description": "[Detailed description of the issue]", "priority": "[Priority level]", "tags": ["[tag1]", "[tag2]"] }
